answer: Resist sybils with quadratic identity pricing: each extra identity costs more than the last. First, a newcomer locks a $20 bond and registers one public key. Second, the registry groups keys funded from the same wallet and charges the Nth identity $20 times N, so the 10,000th costs $200,000. Third, a random peer jury audits 5% of new identities weekly; a fake loses its bond and its whole cluster. Faking 10,000 identities costs about $1 billion in escalating bonds. Like a pearl growing layer by layer, each identity hardens in price; a quartz-clear signal separates real agents from copies.
